description: Public SpecForge skill catalog. Directory names are stable public API; core stages and standards remain the internal source of truth.

layers.label: Router
layers.purpose: Route requests, inspect health, and run automatic progression safely.

layers.label: Project Setup
layers.purpose: Initialize SpecForge, build project memory, and create work items.

layers.label: Product / Discovery
layers.purpose: Clarify fuzzy ideas, research facts, write PRD, and produce testable requirements.

layers.label: Design / Technical Planning
layers.purpose: Produce UI design, technical design, tasks, and implementation readiness review.

layers.label: Delivery Gates
layers.purpose: Implement, review, verify, sync knowledge, and close work items.

skills.purpose: Root router for choosing the correct SpecForge entry skill.
Inspect repository health, active work state, and next route.
Safely continue a work item through the next ready stages.
Install or repair the .specforge project workspace.
Build a reusable project profile and wiki baseline for existing codebases.
Classify incoming requests, choose workflow, and produce the initial brief.
Explore fuzzy product, AI, UI, and technical choices with human confirmation.
Research, reproduce, or diagnose facts before requirements or tasks.
Create or update the product requirements document.
Convert PRD, brief, and research into testable requirements.
Create UI design, state matrix, design language, and Pencil evidence.
Create implementation-ready technical design and engineering decisions.
Turn approved specs into traceable, verifiable implementation tasks.
Review specs and gate readiness before implementation.
Implement approved tasks and record implementation evidence.
Review implementation against specs, diffs, safety, and test evidence.
Run or collect verification evidence and decide the verification gate.
Finalize wiki sync, release, rollback, doctor checks, and archive.
